limits: No solver or numerical test was executed by this audit.
Wall times are checked against preserved launch records, not reconstructed from log timestamps.
Shared single host; one mesh, 1/2 ranks, two element workers, one library thread, three measured pairs plus a warmup pair per rank count.
Per-step maximum-rank timers overlap and cannot be added to reconstruct wall time.
PETSc event counts are maximum rank counts; ratios and times are printed at limited precision.
Current build identity and incremental log supersede the inherited historical build receipt for source provenance.
Both production changes are enabled together; this campaign does not isolate their individual wall-time effects.
